description: List the makers on MakerRadar ranked by their products' all-time upvotes, with how many products each has listed. Paged by cursor; keep going until nextCursor is null.

cursor.description: Where the previous page stopped: its `nextCursor`, passed back unchanged. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many makers to return (default 50, at most 1000).

name: list_makers

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

title: The makers' leaderboard
